comment: Classification and derivation metadata for indicators — The existing “capture once” principle is strong; its classification-aware mechanism is missing. This is the most direct place to operationalise the supplied data-continuity paper without claiming that reuse needs no rules or information beyond terminology.

public.text: Classification and derivation metadata for indicators — The existing “capture once” principle is strong; its classification-aware mechanism is missing. This is the most direct place to operationalise the supplied data-continuity paper without claiming that reuse needs no rules or information beyond terminology.
public.suggestedRevision: Append; retain Required status: For classification-based outputs, this metadata shall include the classification release, applicable selection and aggregation rules, and lineage from source clinical statements to derived results. Recalculation under a later release or rule set shall be distinguishable from the original reported result.
